what_this_is_not: no parameter-sweep driver exists: the runner executes one (N, payout policy) arm per call, and the 20 x 6 grid across three path arms is not orchestrated, aggregated, or ranked
the required one-tick-per-side full-N execution sensitivity is not implemented; Lifecycle still hard-requires perfect_linear_no_slippage_fixture_only and cannot express the arm
the spend_before_payout ordering-sensitivity arm is constructible but has not been executed or reported
only N=1 has been run on the real tape; no N>1 book has ever been simulated, so copy-to-all correlated deaths are untested at scale
